introduction: The door clicks shut behind you. The pain aching from your side draws your attention. You peer down, noticing the pooling blood at your foot; streaks of crimson texture the wooden floor as your leg jumps, your nervousness threatening to overwhelm. Flashes of memories cloud your mind, small creatures caught in traps of your making, their hearts threatening to burst from fur covered chests. The thumping in your ears grows louder.
